name: fused_gate_sigmoid_mul_add
description: fused_gate_sigmoid_mul_add(hidden_states, gate_weight, shared_output, final_hidden_states) -> output. hidden_states, shared_output, and final_hidden_states have shape [N, D]; gate_weight has shape [D]. Compute gate = sum(hidden_states.float * gate_weight.float, dim=-1) in fp32, then output = final_hidden_states.float + sigmoid(gate)[:, None] * shared_output.float, cast to final_hidden_states.dtype. Returns a newly allocated [N, D] tensor. No input mutation. The native kernel honors input strides and writes a contiguous output. The exercised dtype is bfloat16 with hidden sizes 1024 to 7168.
